content_zh:
独留在原地的云茵一口银牙咬得咯咯作响，早知诸葛远舟吃这套，她就先躺过去好了。
不对！本来就是她要做的，被季月抢先了一步！
真是气死她了！
郊外的别院雅致清幽，随从手脚麻利地沏好龙井茶，给诸葛远舟和季月各倒一杯。
青瓷茶盏里，碧绿的茶叶在水中舒展，香气袅袅。
“你是季月吧？”
诸葛远舟语气几乎笃定，他曾在父皇给的画像中见过祝宗门的徒弟，加上云茵又叫她为季小姐，长得像还同姓，世上哪有这样巧的事。
季月不知对方目的，战术饮茶，“你是三皇子吧？”
诸葛远舟俊隽儒雅的脸上划过一抹诧色，像是根本没想到她会知晓他的身份，他也端起茶盏小啜起来。
“季小姐说笑，我粗人一个，怎么会是当朝皇子。”
季月便道：“公子也说笑了，我美人一个，怎么是天山宗鼎鼎有名的大大大美人季月。”
诸葛远舟：“……”
二人一时之间没人说话，仅有喝茶声你来我往。
季月属实不会品茶，把茶当水喝，随从就在她身旁给她添茶，很快一壶龙井茶都被她喝完了。
诸葛远舟想起从京城一路过来的听闻，季月的五灵根被妖兽挖去成为废人。堂堂宗主徒弟，沦落到在马路上碰瓷，大概率是天山宗其他弟子借机踩高捧低，想来她是受了不少委屈。
天下人都说祝宗主宠爱女徒弟季月，可今日一见，事实并非如此，修仙界果然冷漠残酷。
“我给你银票，你缺钱花就去钱庄支取。”他眼神夹杂着几分怜悯，给随从示意带人取银票。
季月暗道还有这种好事，忙放下茶杯，跟上随从去屋中。
她将十张千两银票收入锦囊，出来客客气气的跟诸葛远舟道谢：“公子真是个好人，好人一生平安，一胎一百零八个，个个梁山好汉。”
诸葛远舟婉言拒绝：“…大可不必。”

一百零八个孩子，他的皇兄指定夜不能寐，连夜派刺客来问候他，时时刻刻提防着他举家造反。
眼见天色渐暗，夕阳的余晖染红了半边天。
季月走回天山宗不现实，天那么黑，她一个美人会遭人惦记的。
“我可以在你这借住一晚吗？”
诸葛远舟点头应允：“可以。”
多可怜啊，连天山宗都回不去，住的地方都没有，也只有他人心善收留她了。

content_en:
Yun Yin, who was left alone, gritted her silver teeth. If she had known that Zhuge Yuanzhou was going to do this, she would have lay down first.
wrong! It was what she wanted to do, but Ji Yue beat her to it!
She was so angry!
The courtyard in the suburbs was elegant and quiet. The attendant quickly brewed Longjing tea and poured a cup for Zhuge Yuanzhou and Ji Yue each.
In the celadon tea cup, the green tea leaves are stretched in the water, and the fragrance is lingering.
"Are you Ji Yue?"
Zhuge Yuanzhou's tone was almost certain. He had seen Zhu Zongmen's apprentice in the portrait given by his father. In addition, Yun Yin called her Miss Ji. She looked similar and had the same surname. How could there be such a coincidence in the world.
Ji Yue didn't know the other party's purpose and drank tea tactically, "You are the third prince, right?"
A look of surprise flashed across Zhuge Yuanzhou's handsome and elegant face, as if he didn't expect that she would know his identity. He also picked up the tea cup and started to sip.
"Miss Ji is joking, I am a rough guy, how can I be the current prince?"
Ji Yue then said: "Young Master is also joking. I am a beauty. How can I be Ji Yue, the famous beauty of Tianshan Sect?"
Zhuge Yuanzhou: "..."
No one spoke to the two of them for a while, only the sound of drinking tea came and went.
Ji Yue really didn't know how to taste tea, so she drank the tea as water. The attendant was beside her and gave her more tea, and soon she finished the whole pot of Longjing tea.
Zhuge Yuanzhou remembered what he heard all the way from the capital, that Ji Yue's five spiritual roots were dug up by monsters and became a useless person. The disciple of the majestic sect master was reduced to a quarrel on the street. It was most likely that other disciples of the Tianshan sect took the opportunity to flatter her and flatter her. She must have suffered a lot of grievances.
Everyone in the world said that Master Zhu doted on his female disciple Ji Yue, but when they met today, it was not the case. The world of immortality was indeed cold and cruel.
"I'll give you a banknote. If you need money, go to the bank and withdraw it." With a hint of pity in his eyes, he signaled to his entourage to take someone to get the banknote.
Ji Yue secretly thought that there was such a good thing, so she quickly put down her tea cup and followed her entourage to the house.
She put ten thousand-tael silver notes into her brocade bag and came out to thank Zhuge Yuanzhou politely: "Young Master is such a good man. A good man has a safe life. He gave birth to a hundred and eight children, and they are all heroes of Liangshan."
Zhuge Yuanzhou declined politely: "...No need."
One hundred and eight children, his royal brother kept him awake all night, sent assassins to greet him all night, and was always on guard against his family rebellion.
Seeing the sky getting darker, the afterglow of the setting sun dyed half of the sky red.
It's unrealistic for Ji Yue to walk back to Tianshan Sect. It's so dark and a beauty like her will be missed.
"Can I stay at your place for one night?"
Zhuge Yuanzhou nodded in agreement: "Okay."
How pitiful, she couldn't even go back to the Tianshan Sect, she didn't even have a place to live, and only others were kind enough to take her in.

Ji Yue glanced at the barrage. She had long lost her excitement for the gift. Only sports cars and hot air balloons in the world could attract her attention.
She was lying in the guest room in the west wing, having forgotten something.
The ghost was squatting in the corner outside the courtyard, separated from Ji Yue by a wall. The wind was blowing, and the leaves were rolling up and falling on his head. He was a ghost who looked weak and helpless.
